comment: The 2017 champ has finished T13 or better in five of seven starts this year and sits second in Strokes Gained: Approach. I'm in.

I will enjoy being the test case in Bolton's lab for this selection. He enters the week on three consecutive top-10 paydays, including a victory at Pebble Beach. If I have learned anything over the years, I have learned that TPC Sawgrass rewards the in-form player. My only regret is not having Si Woo Kim for such an occasion!
This is not the time to overthink. This event has proven that it rewards players who are in form. If that’s the case, there’s no more natural pick.

I’ll buy the dip, even if it’s just a small one. Everyone is worried about his iron play — 88 th  in SG: Approach this year — and I’ll take that as an opportunity to capitalize with him as my captain.
We saw flashes of the Scheffler we know and love Saturday down the back nine at Bay Hill. Expecting him to return to his mean of excellence this week.
